name: mono
label: Mono
css: .style-mono { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 60px; background-color: var(--surface, #E7E5E4); position: relative; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; } .style-mono::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(55, 247, 18, 0.03) 0%, rgba(0, 166, 244, 0.02) 100%); pointer-events: none; } .style-mono .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text, #78716B); letter-spacing: -2px; max-width: 90%; word-break: break-word; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-mono .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--text, #78716B); max-width: 85%; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-mono .step { font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: var(--text, #78716B); opacity: 0.08; position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 40px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -4px; } .style-mono .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; color: var(--text, #78716B); position: absolute; bottom: 40px; left: 40px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-mono { background-color: #1a1a1a; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(55, 247, 18, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(rgba(55, 247, 18, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; } .slide-code.style-mono .hook, .slide-code.style-mono .text, .slide-code.style-mono .step, .slide-code.style-mono .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #37F712); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(55, 247, 18, 0.3); } .slide-code.style-mono .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #37F712); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-mono { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #37F712); } .slide-insight.style-mono .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #37F712); text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(55, 247, 18, 0.25); } .slide-insight.style-mono .text { color: #ffffff; } .slide-insight.style-mono .insight-text { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: #ffffff; background: rgba(55, 247, 18, 0.08); padding: 24px 28px; border-radius: 4px; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; } .slide-insight.style-mono .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #37F712); opacity: 0.2; } .slide-insight.style-mono .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #37F712); }
